title: Long exact derived sequence for a short exact sequence of additive functors
statement: In an abelian category C with injective resolutions [def-sp-abelian, def-sp-injective-resolutions], let A,B,E be additive functors to abelian groups [def-sp-left-exact-additive] and a:A→B, c:B→E natural transformations. If a is injective, (a,c) exact, and c surjective on every injective object, there exist natural transformations δ_n:R^n E→R^{n+1} A such that R^n a,R^n c,δ_n,R^{n+1} a form three exact adjacent pairs at every object, for every natural n.

source.place: Tag 0A50, passage from an injective section sequence to the homology long exact sequence; Homology Tag 0117

proof.text: Evaluate the transformations on a chosen injective resolution. Function.Exact implies the zero composite. Degreewise injectivity, exactness and surjectivity imply short exactness of the evaluated complex sequence.
Conjugate the homology boundary by isoRightDerivedObj. Lift coefficient morphisms to resolutions; the induced short-complex morphism and δ_naturality prove naturality of the conjugated boundary.

Transport homology_exact₂, homology_exact₃ and homology_exact₁ across resolution comparisons. rightDerived_app_eq identifies all transformed maps; exact_iff_of_surjective_of_bijective_of_injective transports Function.Exact.

lean.statement:
theorem rightDerived_injective_sequence
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasInjectiveResolutions C]
    (A B E : C ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w}) [A.Additive] [B.Additive] [E.Additive]
    (a : A ⟶ B) (c : B ⟶ E)
    (hinj : ∀ (I : C), Injective I → Function.Injective (a.app I))
    (hexact : ∀ (I : C), Injective I → Function.Exact (a.app I) (c.app I))
    (hsurj : ∀ (I : C), Injective I → Function.Surjective (c.app I)) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ n : ℕ, E.rightDerived n ⟶ A.rightDerived (n + 1),
      ∀ (M : C) (n : ℕ),
        Function.Exact ((a.rightDerived n).app M) ((c.rightDerived n).app M) ∧
        Function.Exact ((c.rightDerived n).app M) ((δ n).app M) ∧
        Function.Exact ((δ n).app M) ((a.rightDerived (n + 1)).app M)
